crossRefs.note: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases…
Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.
When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was in the house.
from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what…
and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick, on their mats, to where they heard he was.

translations.web: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region, and brought to him all who were sick;
translations.bsb: And when the men of that place recognized Jesus, they sent word to all the surrounding region. People brought all the sick to Him
translations.kjv: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
translations.asv: And when the men of that place knew him, they sent into all that region round about, and brought unto him all that were sick,
